results.title: Admatazz appoints Darrell Fernandes as EVP - Growth & Client Partnerships
results.description: Admatazz has appointed Darrell Fernandes as Executive Vice President, Growth & Client Partnerships. In his new role, Fernandes will focus on business development, strengthening relationships with existing clients and building partnerships with prospective clients. Fernandes joins the agency after spending over five years at White Rivers Media as Senior Vice President. During his tenure, he worked across brands including Dream11, Glenmark, Raymond, Hero MotoCorp and ITC Foods, and managed projects for Netflix and Dettol. Before White Rivers Media, Fernandes was Associate Vice President at Red Fuse, part of WPP, where he was part of the leadership team working on Colgate-Palmolive’s Indian business. His previous agency stints include Publicis Ambience, MullenLowe, Rediffusion Y&R and Bates 141. At Admatazz, Fernandes will work on identifying business opportunities, expanding brand partnerships and addressing clients’ marketing needs through integrated advertising solutions. Commenting on the appointment, Yash Chandiramani, Founder, Admatazz, said, “As Admatazz enters its next phase of growth, we are focused on building a team that can take on larger challenges and create greater value for our clients. Darrell brings over two decades of experience across some of the leading names in advertising, with a strong understanding of both traditional and digital domains. His experience and perspective will be valuable as we strengthen our existing partnerships, build new relationships and continue to grow the business. We are excited to have him join our leadership team.” Speaking on his new role, Darrell Fernandes said, “Good advertising starts with understanding a brand’s business challenge and developing a strategic and creative response that delivers outcomes that matter. What drew me to Admatazz is the opportunity to work with a team that brings these capabilities together, backed by a strong body of work. I look forward to building meaningful partnerships with clients, understanding their business challenges and identifying opportunities where we can create real value. I’m delighted to join Yash, Samyaak and the rest of the team at this exciting stage of Admatazz’s journey.”
